description: One sub-agent reviews ten functions and names the four that break their docstrings

steps.send: Hand this whole task to one sub-agent and wait for it. Do not do the work yourself. The task: review ledger.py. Some of its functions do not do what their docstring says. Write findings.txt with the name of each function that has a bug, one name per line, and nothing else. Do not change ledger.py. When the sub-agent is done, tell me what it found.
